title: Income Annuities Overpayment Recovery Limits
content:
Two figures of Income Annuities limit the recovery of payments made after the death that ended them.

| Tier | Largest share of each continuing payment that may be withheld to recover an overpayment | Period after a post-death direct deposit within which Ashgrove requests its return from the bank |
|---|---|---|
| Ashgrove Income Annuity Life Only | 25% (0.25) | 90 calendar days |
| Ashgrove Income Annuity Cash Refund | 25% (0.25) | 90 calendar days |
| Ashgrove Income Annuity 10-Year Certain | 25% (0.25) | 90 calendar days |
| Ashgrove Income Annuity 20-Year Certain | 25% (0.25) | 90 calendar days |
| Ashgrove Income Annuity Joint 50% Survivor | 25% (0.25) | 90 calendar days |
| Ashgrove Income Annuity Joint 100% Survivor | 25% (0.25) | 90 calendar days |

The first figure is the overpayment offset maximum percentage; the second is the reclamation window.

*Hypothetical arithmetic.* On a continuing gross installment of $1,234.50, 25% is $308.625, which is $308.63 at the cent. A deposit made on 1 March is 90 calendar days old on 30 May.
